subject: Leaf Blower Ordinance
overview: The Committee of the Whole reviewed draft regulations on seasonal leaf blower use, hours of operation, and noise limits with DPW Commissioner Tim McGivern and City Attorney Janelle Austin. The council approved consolidated drafting instructions—including a phased two-year ban on gas-powered blowers—and voted to retain the paper in committee.

items.title: Paper 21-057: Leaf Blower Ordinance
items.summary: The committee discussed draft restrictions on leaf blower hours, decibel levels, and seasonal windows, voting to advance consolidated amendments to phase out gas-powered blowers over two years, require commercial operators to provide personal protective equipment, broaden exemptions for city properties, research constant-use noise limits with legal counsel, and invite local landscaping businesses and the Chamber of Commerce to a future meeting.

items.title: Retention in Committee
items.summary: The committee voted to keep Paper 21-057 in committee for further revision and stakeholder input.
